chunks: And they will wake up suddenly.

key_terms.السَّاهِرَةِ: The place of sudden awakening or the moment of realization on the Day of Judgment.

ai.seo_question: What does 'Al-Saharah' mean in the context of the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Saharah' (the pit or abyss) is often interpreted as a specific, low-lying region of Hell reserved for those who were arrogant and heedless in their worldly lives, emphasizing the suddenness of their realization. This verse underscores the concept of 'ghaflah' (heedlessness) as the primary cause of spiritual ruin, where the disbelievers awaken to their fate only when it is too late to repent. The imagery serves as a warning against the illusion of worldly permanence and the inevitability of divine reckoning.
